semantics: The original client intercepts Personal Assistant reply links whose href contains /pa-action/. It splits the href on '/', passes segments 4 and 5 as the endpoint id and action, and invokes a POST with no request body. The thunk reads only response.data.done; when done is truthy it refreshes auth data, refreshes the authenticated company's messages, and marks the PA message as handled in Redux. The id/action values are dynamic link data rather than a client-side reward catalog. The only concrete special-case identifier visible in this path is trustpilot/0 (redirects to app reviews when supported); no generic reward, cost, resource delta, or action-to-message ownership semantics are established.

observed.meaning: special client-side app-review redirect; not a game reward

fairTestOnly.meaning: Existing private-server test exercises a separate local fair exchange route; it does not establish generic PA reward semantics.

models: achievements and company_achievements store achievement rewards

missingPrerequisite: A persisted PA/tutorial offer or action model is required that links an authenticated company's PA message to an allowed id/action and defines its preconditions, exact reward/resource deltas, completion state, and replay behavior. Existing personal_assistant selection, PA unlock purchases, tutorial constants, and achievement claims do not provide that mapping, so a generic reward mutation would be speculative.
